New year, new faces: member mixer

  • Wed, Jan 13 · 7 to 9 pm
  • Longwood · Free

Are you in?

I'm in
GML+4144 going (DEMO)

Part of January’s lineup, which drops Tue, Dec 15 at noon (DEMO). You can save a seat now.

This one already happened. Here’s what’s next.

Meet the people, find your thing, ask anything. Pizza's on us (DEMO).

What's the plan

January is dues month, so this is our big hello. Meet the people who run things, try a few ways to plug in (events, issues, making videos, Spanish-language outreach), and ask whatever you want. Dues are $20 a year, paid in January. Can't pay because of money or citizenship status? Non-voting membership is there for you, and nobody asks for money at the door. There's a renewal table too: renew your mail-ballot request on your own phone, on the official site, with someone there to help.

Getting in

Name tags with optional pronouns. A quieter table for smaller conversations. Vegetarian and gluten-free pizza (DEMO).

When
Wed, Jan 13 · 7 to 9 pm

Who it's for

14 to 39 for membership; everyone 14 and up can come. You don't have to be a member, and you don't have to be registered with any party.

Under 18? Events that end after dark, and door-knocking shifts, need a quick OK from a parent or guardian. We'll send the form when you RSVP.

Alcohol-free
All our events are alcohol-free.

DEMO host · Room for 70 (DEMO)

What to bring

  • Yourself, as you are
  • A friend
  • Your Florida license or ID number, if you want to renew your mail-ballot request at the table

First time? Here's what happens

  1. Tap I’m in. A first name and one way to reach you, that’s it. No account.

  2. The day before, you get one reminder with the details.

  3. Show up, look for the celery-green sign (DEMO), and someone will say hi and introduce you around.

Where the facts on this page come from

  • YDSC membership dues are $20 a year, paid during January unless a member joins later in the year.

    Source: secure.actblue.com

  • Non-voting membership is for people who can't pay dues for reasons such as citizenship status or financial hardship.

    Source: secure.actblue.com

  • Membership is open to people at least 14 and under 40.

    Source: secure.actblue.com

Links checked Nov 9, 2026.

The fine print

We ask before we post anyone's photo, and a parent or guardian says yes first for anyone under 18. Rather not be in pictures? Tell us at check-in.

We never collect forms, signatures or personal information at events. You do everything yourself on official sites.

Be kind, let people finish their sentences, and look out for each other. Anyone who harasses someone is asked to leave.
